3	// The grammar is deliberately tiny and stable across all subcommands:

9	// first `--` is captured verbatim into `passthrough` and is NOT interpreted by
10	// the framework. That is what lets `fast`/`cycle` forward an engine's whole
11	// native CLI (e.g. `-gdb tcp::1234 -S`) untouched, so users see one simulator.

########## FINAL dry_run.sh ##########
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# --dry-run applies to ALL run modes (fast, cycle, hybrid): it prints the exact
# command(s) andesim WOULD spawn, shell-quoted, and executes nothing. Regression
# guard for the bug where fast/cycle silently ignored --dry-run and ran the
# program (e.g. `run --mode fast hello.elf --dry-run` printed "hello").
#
# Layers:
#   1. fast   (always; needs only build/andesim + a fixture ELF): prints the
#      full qemu command, exit 0, executes nothing.
#   2. cycle  (needs a built vsim engine; SKIPs otherwise): the vsim standalone
#      command, exit 0, executes nothing.
#   3. hybrid (regression): still prints 2 commands.
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"
BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"
[ -x "$BIN" ] || fail "missing andesim binary: $BIN"
elf=$(ls "$ROOT"/tests/fixtures/handoff_roundtrip.elf 2>/dev/null \
      || ls "$ROOT"/tests/fixtures/*.elf 2>/dev/null | head -1)
[ -n "$elf" ] || fail "no fixture ELF under tests/fixtures"

# 1. fast: --dry-run prints the full qemu command and runs nothing. Use the
#    reported arg order (flag AFTER the ELF) to lock the repro.
out=$(timeout 30 "$BIN" run --mode fast "$elf" --dry-run 2>&1); rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "fast --dry-run exit $rc (should preview, not run): $out"
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'dry-run: 1 command' \
  || fail "fast --dry-run did not print the preview banner (it executed?): $out"
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q -- '-machine andes_ae350' \
  || fail "fast --dry-run missing the qemu command: $out"
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q -- '-bios' \
  || fail "fast --dry-run missing -bios <elf>: $out"
ok "fast: --dry-run prints the full qemu command, executes nothing"

# Resolve a built vsim engine the way the driver does (VSIM_BIN_DIR env, then
# config.env), else the legacy in-tree build dir.
vsim_bin_dir() {
  if [ -n "${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-}" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$VSIM_BIN_DIR"; return; fi
  local v
  v=$(grep -oP 'VSIM_BIN_DIR=\K.*' "$ROOT/config.env" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '"' | head -1)
  [ -n "$v" ] && printf '%s\n' "$v" || printf '%s\n' "$ROOT/verilator/build"
}
BINDIR=$(vsim_bin_dir)
SIM=$(ls "$BINDIR"/sim_* 2>/dev/null | grep -vE '\.(json|txt)$' | head -1)
if [ -z "$SIM" ] || [ ! -x "$SIM" ]; then
  ok "SKIP cycle + hybrid --dry-run: no built vsim engine under $BINDIR (set VSIM_BIN_DIR)"
  exit 0
fi
id="vsim:$(basename "$SIM" | sed 's/^sim_//')"

# 2. cycle: standalone vsim engine, --dry-run previews its command, runs nothing.
out=$(timeout 30 env VSIM_BIN_DIR="$BINDIR" "$BIN" run --mode cycle --dry-run \
      --engine "$id" "$elf" 2>&1); rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "cycle --dry-run exit $rc (should preview, not run): $out"
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'dry-run: 1 command' \
  || fail "cycle --dry-run did not print the preview banner (it executed?): $out"
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "$(basename "$SIM")" \
  || fail "cycle --dry-run missing the vsim command: $out"
ok "cycle: --dry-run prints the vsim standalone command, executes nothing"

# 3. hybrid regression: still 2 commands (probe -> stage -> inject path intact).
out=$(timeout 30 env VSIM_BIN_DIR="$BINDIR" "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker \
      --dry-run --engine "$id" "$elf" 2>&1)
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'dry-run: 2 command' \
  || fail "hybrid --dry-run regression: not 2 commands: $out"
ok "hybrid: --dry-run still prints 2 commands"
########## FINAL trigger_gating.sh ##########
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# run trigger/pc gating: --trigger / --pc-start / --pc-end are the hybrid ROI
# delimiters. fast/cycle used to silently IGNORE them -- a user asking for a
# pc window got a whole-program cycle figure with no warning. They are now
# rejected (rc 2) on any model except hybrid.
#
#   1. cycle/fast + --trigger          -> usage error (rc 2)
#   2. cycle/fast + --pc-end           -> usage error (rc 2)
#   3. cycle/fast + --pc-start         -> usage error (rc 2)
#   5. hybrid + --trigger pc + pc-*    -> never gated (reaches the ELF check)
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/paths.sh"

BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"
bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"

FIXTURE="${FIXTURE:-rt_c_hello}"
hybrid_resolve_paths
ENGINE="${ENGINE:-vsim:ax45mpv_premium}"
MISSING=/no/such/file.elf

# 1-3. fast/cycle reject the hybrid-only ROI knobs (real ELF: pre-gate these
# ran the whole program and returned 0; the gate must now turn them into rc 2).
expect 2 'trigger applies only to --mode hybrid' \
  "$BIN" run --mode cycle --engine "$ENGINE" --trigger pc \
  --pc-start 0x100074 --pc-end 0x100080 "$VSIM_ELF"
expect 2 'trigger applies only to --mode hybrid' \
  "$BIN" run --mode fast --trigger marker "$VSIM_ELF"
expect 2 'pc-end applies only to --mode hybrid' \
  "$BIN" run --mode cycle --engine "$ENGINE" --pc-end 0x100080 "$VSIM_ELF"
expect 2 'pc-start applies only to --mode hybrid' \
  "$BIN" run --mode cycle --engine "$ENGINE" --pc-start 0x100074 "$VSIM_ELF"
expect 2 'pc-start applies only to --mode hybrid' \
  "$BIN" run --mode fast --pc-start 0x100074 "$VSIM_ELF"
ok "fast/cycle reject --trigger/--pc-start/--pc-end"

# 5. hybrid is the home of these flags: never gated, reaches the ELF check.
expect 2 'ELF not found' \
  "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger pc --engine "$ENGINE" \
  --pc-start 0x100074 --pc-end 0x100080 "$MISSING"
ok "hybrid --trigger pc not gated"

ok "run trigger/pc gating (hybrid-only)"
